sources.title: RAFAELIA — NOVOexport Raw 018 Wave 3 — PID Hash Reconciliation — 2026-08-24

cursor.before: PID_INDEX_V5 provenance closed; evidence-class heterogeneity 000..004 unresolved
cursor.after: evidence-class heterogeneity directly enumerated by shard and row cardinality; authority remains non-uniform

interpretation.result: shards 000..004 are consistently represented by provider ID + source SHA + 100 privacy-preserving conversation PID hashes, but evidence_class is not uniform and therefore must not be flattened into RAW_PROVIDER_SHA_JSON_PARSE authority
interpretation.falsifier: if source receipts show equivalent raw-provider byte-stream + JSON-parse evidence for any of 000..004, that shard may be promoted individually after receipt binding; class label alone is insufficient
non_claims: PRIVATE_METADATA_INDEX does not equal current raw-byte custody
V2_METADATA_RECORDS does not equal current raw-byte custody
RAW_ID_TRANSIENT_HASH_ONLY does not equal current raw-byte custody
provider ID + source SHA in an index does not by itself prove a fresh current byte re-download

gaps.evidence_needed: provider object + exact 12115336-byte witness + SHA256 + JSON parse + PID-set reconciliation
gaps.falsifier: byte length, parse, or PID-set digest mismatch
gaps.next_probe: search current Drive aliases/container metadata for conversations-018.json; bind object identity before download/rehash

gaps.evidence_needed: for each shard 000..004: receipt showing source byte/hash/parse provenance appropriate to claimed authority
gaps.falsifier: receipt proves weaker or different evidence than index class/authority assumption
gaps.next_probe: bulk-search Drive for receipts/manifests keyed by provider IDs and source SHA256 of shards 000..004
gaps.owner_authority: Drive source custody + Mapa provenance registry
gaps.closure_gate: provider_id→source_sha256→upstream receipt→evidence class normalization decision per shard

memory_projection.L: follows merged PR431 and preserves the v5 single-revision/digest receipt without rewrite
memory_projection.O: three direct bounded searches independently enumerate all 500 non-default evidence rows
memory_projection.T: Drive PID index ↔ shard-specific provider IDs/source SHA ↔ Mapa receipt
memory_projection.C: 50/51 index coverage remains unchanged; only evidence-authority depth for 000..004 increased
memory_projection.P: provider IDs, revision ID, source SHA and immutable audit path recorded append-only

uncertainty.before: evidence classes 000..004 known only as heterogeneous aggregate
uncertainty.after: exact shard-to-class/provider/source-hash mapping observed for all 5 shards; upstream receipt authority still open

next_probes: bulk-search Drive receipts/manifests by provider IDs and source SHA256 for shards 000..004
search RAW018 aliases/container/provider identity without inferring from filename
only after exact binding, verify RAW018 12115336 bytes→SHA256→JSON parse→PID-set reconciliation
F_ok: evidence-class heterogeneity for shards 000..004 fully enumerated at row/provider/hash level; no false normalization
